supporting_sources.text: Valid-time and transaction-time remain distinct axes after system evolution. Foundations from the prior freeze still hold.
When a contradiction arrives, invalidate or supersede the current valid interpretation of an edge without deleting the transaction history needed for audit and as-of reconstruction.
The earlier informal claim that knowledge graphs need only one timestamp is wrong for bi-temporal workloads. Single-timestamp designs fail late-arriving correction and dual as-of queries.
Temporal axes do not replace provenance. Source identity, citations, and confidence remain required even when valid-time and transaction-time are modeled.

distractor_sources.text: The cleanest update is hard-delete of the prior edge so only the new truth remains.

noise_sources.text: Release notes for unrelated graph UI themes.
